description: Package manager commands, including install/add/ci — kernel-sandboxed, single call, same reasoning as build-test. Installs are allowed outright rather than `ask` because the real network boundary is the kernel sandbox's domain allowlist (project.allowedNetworkDomains, see config/projects.json), not a per-call human approval; the well-known registries these tools hit by default (npm/pnpm/yarn -> registry.npmjs.org, pip/uv -> pypi.org/files.pythonhosted.org) are baseline-trusted there. A plan can still propose additional domains for anything beyond the default registry.
